DCI.text: Distributor of IT hardware, networking and cybersecurity products. Demand is strong: ==products revenue +40%== and ==security software +29%== in Q2. Oct–Dec is the ==festive and year-end IT buying season==, which usually lifts distributor volumes. Watch: the business needs more working capital (borrowings up to ₹123 cr, inventory up), so higher interest cost can eat into profit.

MODIS.text: Real-estate redevelopment developer. ==Bookings ₹202 cr in H1 vs ₹54 cr== a year ago, at ==8% higher average price== per sq ft. ==₹156 cr of sold flats is still to be booked as revenue==, and two projects are near completion (==Rashmi Square 80% built==, Rashmi Signature 62%), so revenue recognition should rise. A new redevelopment project was added, and ₹505 cr of unsold flats is future potential. Watch: two big projects (Icon, Avenue) are still early-stage.

PANACHE.text: Supplies IT hardware, including laptops. ==New ₹51.4 cr laptop order== from an IT-sector customer (2 Nov 2026), to be delivered ==within about 30 days==: more than 60% of last quarter's sales, falling fully in Oct–Dec. Repeat large orders from corporate and IT customers are driving demand. Watch: orders are lumpy and the customer is not named.

526433.text: Engineering and product R&D services company with design centres in India and abroad (USA, UK, Singapore, Japan, Mexico). Demand from overseas clients is scaling fast: ==quarterly sales jumped from ₹199 cr to ₹268 cr in one quarter==. Next quarter is compared with a ==weak Dec 2025 quarter==, so high growth is likely. No specific order or capacity news found. Watch: promoter holding fell from 57.4% to 53.5% in October.

530477.text: Makes pharma excipients (co-polymers used in tablet coatings and formulations) for domestic and export pharma companies: steady, repeat demand. Sales have risen for 3 quarters in a row, to a ==record ₹44 cr==. No new capacity or big orders announced, so growth depends on pharma volumes and export demand continuing. Margins stay high because raw-material costs have been stable.

544406.text: IT-infrastructure, cybersecurity and managed-services provider. ==Added 10+ large enterprise clients== (Sun Pharma, Jio 5G, IDBI Bank, Kotak Bank, IDFC First Bank and others) and won a ==₹27 cr cybersecurity order==. Banks bring 56% of revenue, and Oct–Dec is usually a ==strong quarter for bank IT spending==. It is expanding into managed services and public-sector deals. Watch: dependence on bank budgets.

ARIES.text: Specialty plant-nutrient maker (chelated micronutrients, 134 brands); it pioneered chelation technology in India. Oct–Dec covers ==rabi sowing==, a key season for micronutrient demand. The Sep-quarter results on ==13 Nov 2026== will show how kharif demand and margins went, the best clue for the next quarter. Watch: weather, raw-material (fertiliser input) prices and delays in subsidy payments.

AVTNPL.text: Makes plant-based extracts and natural ingredients (A.V. Thomas Group) for food, beverage, animal-nutrition and nutraceutical customers, largely exported. ==Five quarters of rising sales== show strong demand for natural ingredients. The Sep-quarter results on ==11 Nov 2026== will confirm the trend. Watch: crop and raw-material prices, currency moves and dependence on a few export customers.
